question.wording: Is this item a retirement plan contribution made on the owner's own behalf as a self-employed person, rather than for employees?

options.label: Yes — the owner's own contribution (Schedule 1 line 16), not Schedule C

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this item a retirement plan contribution made on the owner's own behalf as a self-employed person, rather than for employees?

citation.wording: If the plan included you as a self-employed person, enter the contributions made as an employer on your behalf on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 16, not on Schedule C.
